text:
emma_csm: FYI — Crestline Health wants to bring their in-house ASR for claims intake. Requirements: PHI, VPC-only, BYOK/HSM, streaming, and p95 latency <=250ms. Renewal flagged if we miss their go-live window.

liam_se: noted. do we have artifact (onnx/torchscript) + model size? streaming chunks or real-time websocket?

emma_csm: they dropped a link to a tarball in the customer portal (16GB onnx + manifest). prefer websocket streaming with partial transcripts.

sana_sg: security: BAA yes, need KMS integration plan for BYOK, HSM key wrapping, and retention window for transcripts. also ask whether they require server-side tokenization redaction.

riley_eval: metrics I'll run: WER, p95 end-to-end latency (streaming), concurrency tail (concurrency 4/8), and error insertions. will include our hosted-asr baseline.

liam_se: early red flags: 16GB onnx might not fit in single GPU for g4dnx family; could need model sharding or larger instance. that affects cost and latency. also ONNX opset compatibility check first.

emma_csm: customer wants a canary by 2026-06-10. can we meet that?

liam_se: aggressive. timeline depends on infra: if we can provision 2x a100-ish or neux nodes in private cluster, yes. need perf trial by 6/1.

sana_sg: legal: requesting contract addendum for PHI handling and egress restrictions. tagging @legal-bot for initial BAA template. also will need SOC2 artifact.

onboard-bot: ticket CS-4922 created: "Crestline ASR private deployment intake" assigned to liam_se.

riley_eval: running a quick smoke run on dev infra now. command: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://perf.internal.redwood/run_eval \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EVAL_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"s3://crestline/asr_v2.onnx","input":"s3://crestline/sample_calls","metrics":["wer","latency_p95","rtf"]}'
```
I will publish summary within 3 hours.

liam_se: followups: 1) ops ticket for node sizing (dedicated-large) 2) fallbacks: route to hosted small-asr on header X-Redwood-Fallback when latency >250ms 3) cost cap alarms for customer.

emma_csm: I'll notify AM/renewal team the moment we have perf numbers. renewal owner is @marco_accounts.

sana_sg: acceptance criteria (proposal): WER <=6.5% on claims set, p95 <=250ms under concurrency=8, RTF <=0.4, no PHI in logs (server-side redact or client-side promise), and BAA signed. please review.

riley_eval: smoke results: WER 6.9%, p95 310ms on default runtime, RTF 0.38. seeing higher tail under bursts. Will try kernel tuning, 8-bit quant, and XNNPACK; then re-run.

liam_se: sounds like tuning path may close the gap. if we still can't hit 250ms, propose staged rollout: 25% traffic on private model, 75% fallback hosted, ramp up as we tune. ensure audit trail for any fallback events.

emma_csm: timeline constraints reiterated: Crestline said "if not live by 6/10 we'll pause renewal conversations". high priority. I'll ask them to sign the BAA and send their infra manifest.

onboard-bot: CS-4922 status -> "triage".

legal-bot: BAA template sent to crestline@crestline.health. Please confirm recipient in thread.

sana_sg: added contract owner @oliver_legal to the ticket.

riley_eval: next update in this thread after tuned run (~6-8 hours). tagging liam_se for infra actions.

liam_se: will open infra sizing and canary runbook today. leaving notes: plan for graceful degrade, observability hooks (per-request latency header), and automatic routing policy based on p95 thresholds.

emma_csm: thanks team. action items summary: liam -> infra + runbook; sana -> security gating + BAA follow; riley -> tuned eval + thresholds; me -> customer comms + renewal owner update. keep thread lean. :thumbsup:
